name: parentTable
label: Parent table
description: The table of the parent record containing the playbook

name: parentSysId
label: Parent Sys ID
description: The Sys ID of the parent record containing the playbook

name: playbookExperienceId
label: Playbook experience
description: The playbook experience that the Playbook should use

name: recordGeneratorQuery
label: Query
description: Encoded query string to optionally override the query provided for a record generator

name: compactMode
label: Compact mode
description: Display this playbook in compact mode for smaller UIs

name: onlyShowSelectedPlaybook
label: Only show selected playbook
description: Boolean to determine if only the selected playbook should be shown.

name: activityView
label: Activity view
description: The activity view determines how activities are displayed in the playbook. Stacked shows all activities for a lane in the work area. Focused shows all activities for a lane in the playbook navigation and one activity at a time in the work area

name: daClientActionContract
label: DA client action contract
description: The contract that UI Builder uses to dynamically build the available declarative actions for event mapping

name: selectedPlaybookContextId
label: Selected playbook context ID
description: The current playbook that should be selected

name: selectedLaneContextId
label: Selected stage context ID
description: The current stage that should be selected

name: selectedActivityContextId
label: Selected activity context ID
description: The current activity that should be selected

name: enableFullWidthCards
label: Enable full-width cards
description: Allow all cards in the playbook to take up the full page width

name: hidePriorityIndicator
label: Hide priority indicator
description: Flag to determine if priority indicators should be hidden.
